description: This file defines the AdvancedSettings React functional component, which provides a user interface for configuring advanced options in a UI related to language model settings. It includes form controls for custom pricing, guardrails, tags, pass-through routes, cache control, and miscellaneous parameters. The component leverages Ant Design and Tremor UI libraries.

methods.name: validateNumber
methods.description: Validates that the input is a non-negative number.

methods.name: handleCustomPricingChange
methods.description: Toggles custom pricing fields and resets their values if disabled.

methods.name: handlePassThroughChange
methods.description: Updates the 'litellm_extra_params' JSON string to include or remove 'use_in_pass_through'.

methods.name: handleCacheControlChange
methods.description: Updates 'litellm_extra_params' JSON string to include or remove cache control injection points.
